lines.text: Her beloved comes leaping across the mountains and stands behind their wall, gazing through the windows.
He calls her to arise and come away, for the winter is past and the season of singing has come.
She asks for the little foxes to be caught, and calls her beloved to be like a gazelle on the mountains of Carmel before the day breaks.
On her bed at night she seeks him without finding him, then searches the city and asks the shepherds whether they have seen him.
She holds him until she brings him to her mother's house, then charges the daughters of Jerusalem not to awaken love until the time is right.
